title: The Hall of the Scales
text: A jackal-headed judge waits beside a golden scale and a single white feather. Behind him something large breathes in the dark. He will weigh each heart, he says, and give back the light ones lighter still. He does not say what he does with the heavy ones.

options.label: Kneel, and pay what it asks.

outcomes.text: Each of you steps onto the scale. You come down lighter, and a little emptier.
It rises from its throne, and it is very much larger standing.

options.label: Take the gift and refuse the price.

outcomes.text: The leader puts a thumb on the scale. The judge sees, and stands.
The thumb slips. The heart is weighed heavy, and the judge stands.
